value.rationale: The all-dimensional first-two-power-sum cancellation criterion at moment order eight is a natural exact flatness/phase-balancing invariant for cross-polytope Fourier supports. It gives explicit sharp moments in every d>=4, rigid regular-polygon minimizers in d=4 and d=5, and a genuine phase-alphabet divisibility transition (ternary versus quaternary). These are precise naturally motivated structural and classification conclusions not inferable from the known d=3 identity alone.
